tagline: A leading owner and operator of retail real estate focused on the Washington, D.C. to Boston corridor
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary driver of value creation in UE's business model: rent increases upon renewals and new leases directly capture asset revaluation and tenant demand in its tight urban markets.

kpis.name: Rent spread (GAAP)
kpis.explanation: Average rent increase upon renewals or new leases, measured under accounting standards.
kpis.description: In 2025, UE signed 40 same-space leases with an average spread of +53.4% on a GAAP basis, reflecting space revaluation in high-density, supply-constrained areas.
kpis.signal: WOW: +53.4% average increase on new leases, signaling strong rental demand.

kpis.name: Occupancy rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of rental space currently leased in the portfolio.
kpis.description: Consolidated portfolio occupancy rate was 90.1% as of December 31, 2025, indicating solid rental performance in a challenging retail sector.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate despite difficult retail environment.

kpis.name: Portfolio size
kpis.explanation: Total gross leasable area of the real estate portfolio.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, the portfolio comprised 69 shopping centers, 2 outlet centers and 2 malls, totaling 17.2 million square feet.
kpis.signal: Concentrated portfolio of 17.2 million square feet within the D.C.-Boston corridor.

kpis.name: Development and repositioning investments
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in development, repositioning and asset restructuring projects.
kpis.description: In 2025, UE activated 11 development/repositioning projects totaling $61.3 million, with a realized return of 14%.
kpis.signal: $61.3 million deployed in projects, generating a gross return of 14%.

kpis.name: Acquisition cap rate
kpis.explanation: Initial gross yield on a real estate acquisition, calculated as net rental income divided by purchase price.
kpis.description: In 2025, UE acquired a property in Allston, MA for $39.2 million at a 5.4% cap rate, demonstrating capability to deploy capital at attractive yields.
kpis.signal: Acquisition at 5.4% cap rate, reflecting an offensive strategy in well-located assets.

kpis.name: Disposition cap rate
kpis.explanation: Yield at which assets were sold, reflecting secondary market valuation.
kpis.description: UE sold three assets for $66.2 million at an average 4.9% cap rate, realizing gains on non-core assets.
kpis.signal: Dispositions at 4.9% cap rate, indicating elevated valuation of non-strategic assets.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €3.31B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €1.67B in the latest year
